name: jarvis
description: Connect Codex to a scoped J.A.R.V.I.S instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped J.A.R.V.I.S tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to J.A.R.V.I.S through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so J.A.R.V.I.S Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use J.A.R.V.I.S only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
